entry.defn: noun new post 趕赴新任 gǎn fù xīnrèn go to take up a new post adjective newly appointed 新任部長 Xīnrèn bùzhǎng newly appointed minister
noun dress; clothing; costume 服裝整齊 fúzhuāng zhěngqí be neatly dressed 民族服裝 mínzú fúzhuāng national or ethnic costume
verb 1 (-//-) climb a mountain 去爬山 Qù páshān go climbing 2 colloquial sports mountain climbing; mountaineering

noun regret; sorrow; remorse 終身的遺憾 zhōngshēn deyíhàn lifelong regret 對此表示遺憾 duì cǐ biǎoshì yíhàn express regret over the matter adjective regretful; sorry 十分遺憾地指出 shífēn yíhàn de zhǐchū point out with great (or deep) regret 一點兒不感到遺憾 yīdiǎnr bù gǎndào yíhàn have no regrets 非常遺憾, 我不能接受你的邀請。 Fēicháng yíhàn, wǒ bùnéng jiēshòu nǐ de yāoqǐng. I am very sorry I will not be able to accept your invitation. 今晚的音樂會你不能來, 實在遺憾。 Jīnwǎn de yīnyuèhuì nǐ bù néng lái, shízài yíhàn. It’s really a pity that you can’t come to the concert this evening. 我遺憾地告訴你, 你考試沒及格。 wǒ yíhàn de gàosu nǐ, nǐ kǎoshì méi jígé. I regret to inform you that you failed the exam.

adjective complete; integrated; intact; entire 完整的工業體系 Wánzhěng de gōngyè tǐxì an integrated (or all-round, comprehensive) industrial system 維護領土完整 wéihù lǐngtǔ wánzhěng safeguard territorial integrity 許多珍貴的歷史文物完整地保存了下來。 Xǔduō zhēnguì de lìshǐ wénwù wánzhěng de bǎocún le xiàlai. Many valuable historical relics have been preserved intact.

noun reality; practice 客觀實際 kèguān shíjì objective reality 從實際出發 cóng shíjì chūfā proceed from actual conditions; realistic 理論和實際 lǐlùn hé shíjì theory and practice 切合當地實際 qièhé dāngdì shíjì suit local conditions 思想經常會落後於實際。 sīxiǎng jīngcháng huì luòhòu yú shíjì. Thinking often lags behind reality. adjective 1 practical; realistic 實際經驗 shíjì jīngyàn practical experience 你這種想法不實際。 Nǐ zhèzhǒng xiǎngfa bù shíjì. You are being unrealistic. 2 real; actual; concrete 實際的例子 shíjì de lìzi concrete instance 實際生活水平 shíjì shēnghuó shuǐpíng real standard of living 實際使用投資 shíjì shǐyòng tóuzī actual utilized investment 石油產量實際增長百分之四。 shíyóu chǎnliàng shíjì zēngzhǎng bǎi fēnzhī sì. Oil production increased by 4% in real terms.
adjective soft and sweet; warm 溫馨的春夜 wēnxīn de chūn yè a balmy spring evening 溫馨的情誼 wēnxīn de qíngyì warm friendship

verb refuse; reject; turn down; decline 拒絕參加 jùjué cānjiā refuse to participate 拒絕發表意見 jùjué fābiǎo yìjian refuse to comment 拒絕無理要求 jùjué wúlǐ yāoqiú turn down (or reject) unreasonable demands 拒絕別人的批評 jùjué biéren de pīpíng reject other’s criticism 斷然拒絕 duànránjùjué flat refusal 婉言拒絕 wǎnyánjùjué graciously decline
noun 1 colloquial (paternal) grandmother; grandma 2 colloquial respectful form of address for an old woman 3 dialect young mistress of the house
